definition.conversations: a run; for MultiTurn one conversation carries the whole battery, so conversations_with_index counts a conversation once if any of its questions used the index
definition.grain: one row per arm × model × exam × battery over the valid, scored runs of the ZeroShot and MultiTurn protocols; HumanExam is whole-battery and has no per-question tool attribution
definition.index_use: a question run counts as using the index when at least one main-thread tool call is an index call: an ArchMap query for TrueArchitect; a call to an installed tool's own MCP surface, excluding its setup calls (listed per arm under setup_tools_excluded); a Skill invocation for a tool that ships as a skill
definition.threads: main thread only — MCP tools are not offered to sub-agent threads
